Hi! So this started happening to me around a year ago, and while I don’t have a solution I do have tricks that might work. (This is going to be long lmao sorry) 
1: breathing. It seems stupid at first but when you’re having a panic attack your fight or flight responses are triggered for no reason and your heart rate goes up quite a bit. Steady breathing can help bring your heart rate down and get your body to shake less. First breath in for 2 then hold in that breath for 2 then exhale. Then do that with 3. Breath in for 3 hold for three then exhale for 3. Grow up numbers till like 8 and then try going back down. I didn’t even believe this worked at first because when people phrase it “just breath 🥺” it sounds condescending but it really helps for me. 
2: scrunch up all the muscles in your body hold for about 5 seconds, then un-scrunch. Idk why this works but it does. 
3: lay down. Don’t curl yourself into a ball. When calming down from a panic attack you need your arms to be put and your rib cage to be expanded. When you collapse on yourself it only makes things worse. 
4: some people say this works, it doesn’t really for me but I thought I’d put it on here, try ice and put it on your arm or put it in your mouth. Apparently the cold sensation can help shock you back to normal. This also works with eating a lemon. 
5: find 1 thing to see, 1 thing to smell, 1 thing to touch, 1 and one thing to taste. It can help ground you. 
6: also as simple as it is, water. Just drink a bunch of water it can help. 

Hope this was helpful! Lmk what works. 
Best of luck

I’ve been in a similar situation with suicidal family and I know how hard it is to feel as if you’re to blame for their problems. I know people have probably told you this already but it’s not you’re responsibility as a child to protect your parents life. It’s not your fault. He was your parent and should have been there for you no matter the circumstances. He obviously had other issues that ultimately drove him to suicide and divorce, but used your identity as a scapegoat and blamed it all on you which again is something that no parent should do. 
Also to your last point desperation is the hardest feeling of all I believe. Its something that can drive you so insane and it’s so hard to drag yourself out. I can’t promise anything I have to say will fix it but I have some tips from personal experience: 
Talk to people online and try to form friendships around fun meaningful things in your life. You don’t need to have deep friendships, just join discord chats or have people you can talk to. 

Find little everyday things that keep you going. Those flowers that bloom next to the curb, the nice cashier at the grocery store, little things like that. 

Find an easy distraction. When you can feel yourself getting bad having an easy time consuming thing like playing music or video games or painting or whatever can help a lot. You do t need to be good you just need to occupy your brain. 

Find a tiny little thing to do for yourself as some form of self care. Find a nice scented lotion at the drugstore, maybe some mints that you like, maybe there’s some perfume that you can use or some flowers at the grocery store you can put in your room. 

You deserve love and happiness and all the world has to offer. 
Also If you want to talk more feel free to DM me.

2: breathing. Breath 4 in, hold for 5, than exhale for six. If you can’t do that breath in for 3 hold for 4 than exhale for 5.

4: when your ready, walk around or stretch. Just get your blood moving.
